items.title: Language unlock working on DSC-TX300V (CX61870_J1) + service-mode pull workaround
items.body:
Sharing a successful language unlock for a Sony Cyber-shot **DSC-TX300V** (Japan-only model, internal name `CX61870`, region `J1`, firmware `22171_03.2012022201`), plus a workaround for a `pull` bug we hit in service mode on this camera.

## Camera info

- Model: DSC-TX300V (Japan)
- Internal: `CX61870_J1`
- Firmware date: 2012-02-22
- `tweak` command in service shell: returned "No tweaks available" – so we had to do it manually

## Language unlock method

The camera has 35 language flags in backup, one byte each, at consecutive IDs starting at `0x010d008f`. Values: `01` = enabled, `02` = disabled.

On a stock J1 camera all are `02` except `0x010d0090` which is `01` (Japanese).

Setting all 35 to `01` unlocks the full language menu. Verified working – language selection menu appeared after reboot, camera runs stable on German. No reboots in the language menu (no unsupported languages detected on this model).

The IDs match the definition already in `pmca/platform/backup.py`:
```python
self.addProp('language', CompoundBackupProp(dataInterface, [(0x010d008f + i, 1) for i in range(35)]))
```

...but `tweak` isn't wired up for this model, so we wrote them directly via `bk.elf` from the on-camera Linux shell:

```sh
# From service shell:
shell

# Enable all 34 non-Japanese language slots (skip 0x90 which is JP, already 01):
for i in 8f 91 92 93 94 95 96 97 98 99 9a 9b 9c 9d 9e 9f a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae af b0 b1; do
  /usr/bin/bk.elf w 010d00$i 01
done
/usr/bin/bk.elf s   # sync to flash
```

Reboot the camera and the language menu is unlocked.

**Note on the region header:** Changing the `CX61870_J1` string in `Backup.bin` at offset `0xC7` to e.g. `CE` writes and persists (unlike on some newer bodies where the firmware reverts it to `J1`), but has no effect on the language menu on this camera. The 35 language flags are the actual gate.

## `pull` bug and workaround

On this camera `pull` reliably fails on the last partial USB chunk. The header reports the correct file size, and 32 KB chunks read cleanly, but the final short chunk (whatever isn't a multiple of `SenserChunkSize = 0x8000`) times out and the file gets truncated at a 32 KB boundary. For a 448278-byte `Backup.bin`, only 425984 bytes come through.

We couldn't fix the underlying USB read cleanly (padding to `SenserMinSize`, splitting the last chunk on 512-byte boundaries, skipping the trailing cleanup read – none of it made the last chunk go through on this camera).

**Workaround that reliably gets the whole file:** pad the source on the camera with zero bytes past the "safe zone", then pull the padded file. Only the padding gets truncated; all real bytes come through intact.

```sh
# From camera Linux shell:
dd if=/dev/zero of=/log/zeros.bin bs=1024 count=100
cat /setting/Backup.bin /log/zeros.bin > /log/padded.bin
# Now /log/padded.bin is ~548 KB; pull it and trim the first 448278 bytes on the host.
```

Same trick works for any file where `pull` truncates. Just make sure the padded size is comfortably past the last 32 KB boundary of the real data.

## Environment

- Windows 11 with Zadig-installed libusb-win32 driver for the service-mode device
- pmca-console launched from source (Python 3.10)
- `pmca-console-v0.18-22-ga82f5ba-win.exe` also works to reach service mode, but the pull bug is the same

Hope this helps anyone else with a stuck-in-Japanese TX300V or nearby model. Happy to share the full `Backup.bin` or the annotated bk.elf dump (11k+ IDs) if useful for further RE.

items.title: Tweak for clean hdmi on Nex 5n (And maybe other nex too)
items.body:
I'm working on updatershell of pmca and I found an bug on my 5n but is good thing. Maybe is an solution for clean hdmi. 

I changed the codec key (id=0x01070087) from AVCHD, value 03, to XAVC, value 0a, but camera don't have this codec. The thing is, when I press the record button the screen was clean, only camera image, no overlay. Then I put hdmi cable and voila, clean hdmi nicely. Maybe this fix can be included in tweak options. To remove this hack is easy, only change video format to avchd again.

items.title: SUCCESS! All languages unlocked on NEX-F3 using my M1 Mac :D
items.body: On 20 June 2024 **MacBook Air M1, Sonoma 14.2.1, Sony Alpha NEX-F3 Camera** Changed my camera's language from Japanese to English **METHOD:** https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE -> **Service Mode** **DISCLAIMER:** I’m just a girl who bought a camera in Japan and got baited by a Google search telling me that this would be super easy, but it was actually really hard because I’ve never used any code thing before and I had no idea what Terminal is on my Mac until yesterday and this took way way way longer than I expected lol **DISCLAIMER 2:** this may be the long way 'round, or the wrong way but you know what I got there in the end so I'm posting this in the very very rare case that it will be helpful (rant at the end) :) **NOTE:** 1. Check if your device is ticked under the **Serviceshell Support** column on https://openmemories.readthedocs.io/devices.html since this is the **Service Method** (not sure what will happen if not) 2. Worked on my M1 MacBook with Apple Silicon, Sonoma 14.2.1 3. It DOES NOT need any extra Sony Camera Drivers or PlayMemories Camera App 4. It _DOES_ need a USB connection from your camera to laptop 5. It _DOES_ need [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/) to be installed on your laptop 6. Below is a step-by-step copy-paste method from beginning to the end. Hopefully you don't run into any errors, otherwise I've only solved **Error 128**. **REFERENCES I USED:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Udunk6HG1uk (the video I got baited by ;-;) https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/issues/327#issuecomment-1376805361 https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/issues/327#issuecomment-2028928348 https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/issues/504#issue-2219426575 **STEPS I TOOK: COPY AND PASTE INSTRUCTIONS** - Install [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/) (I also installed Python on my laptop but idk if I needed to lol) - Open **Terminal** app - Install **Python 3.9** via Homebrew and activate it (I had to use an older version of Python because I ran into the asyncore issue) `brew install python@3.9 ` `python3.9 -m venv myenv39` `source myenv39/bin/activate` - Install the latest tcl-tk for Python for the "_tkinter module not found error" `brew install python-tk@3.9` - Install **libusb** via Homebrew ` brew install libusb` - Clone the Sony-PMCA-RE GitHub repository `git clone https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/` `cd Sony-PMCA-RE/` - Install requirements `pip install -r requirements.txt` **On the camera (in Japanese):** - Enter Menu -> Setup -> USB Connection -> Select **Mass Storage** - Connect the camera to laptop via USB (worked through the charger it came with! and through a usb-C dongle too!) - Turn the camera on (will be in USB setting, should show up on your Mac, I left the SD card in and it still worked) **Back on Terminal** - Run the GUI `sudo ./pmca-gui.py` - Enter your device's password, which opens a window - Check it’s connected by clicking **Get Camera Info** - Go to the **Tweaks** tab - Click **Start Tweaking (service mode)** **My main issue (error 128):** - When I tried to start tweaking I kept running into Senser product info error 128 show below: ``` DO NOT COPY THIS! File "/Users/[USERNAME]/Sony-PMCA-RE/pmca/usb/sony.py", line 987, in _sendProductInfoPacket raise Exception('Senser product info error %d' % res) Exception: Senser product info error 128 ``` **My solution:** - Look for “line 987” in the file "/Users/[USERNAME]/Sony-PMCA-RE/pmca/usb/sony.py” - Then I literally just deleted the condition LOL ``` DO NOT COPY THIS! DELETED LINES: if res != 1: raise Exception('Senser product info error %d' % res) ``` - Install requirements again `pip install -r requirements.txt` - Run the GUI again `sudo ./pmca-gui.py` - Click **Start Tweaking (service mode)** - AND IT FINALLY POPPED UP!!! RANT: Even though I am 100% UNqualified to give advice, I wanted to put this out there because I couldn't find any solution for my specific issue. + there were only a few people who did this with a Mac. I literally watched so many YT videos, tried installing the playmemories thing but my OS is too new... I tried downloading the Sony Driver on my laptop and that didn't do anything? + I couldn't install the latest firmware update for my NEX-F3 bc its JUST THAT OLD I couldn't tweak using the updatershell either because it just crashed my camera lol I even followed this https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/issues/504#issue-2219426575 thread by emulating Linux?? I still don't know what that is?? by downloading Ubuntu through UTM... THAT was a whole ordeal that I don't even want to think about oml It kept running into this issue ``` root@ubuntu:/home/ubuntu/Desktop/Sony-PMCA-RE# sudo ./pmca-console.py serviceshell Using drivers libusb-MSC, libusb-MTP, libusb-vendor-specific Looking for Sony devices Querying mass storage device Sony DSC is a camera in mass storage mode Switching to service mode Waiting for camera to switch... Operation timed out. Please run this command again when your camera has connected. ``` Don't even get me started on trying to get ChatGPT4.o to help because it complicated things so much more by telling me to change the codes, both on Terminal and on Ubuntu which did literally nothing in either systems. And then I tried emulating Windows (which failed miserably) to get Zadig but failed... I've downloaded so many confusing things onto my laptop through links I might actually get a virus and not even know. I've made so many online accounts so that I can download VMware (which didn't even work!) and other things the amount of marketing emails I'm crying. FINALLY I was like "screw it" I'm literally just a girl. I can solve my issue by deleting it. So I retraced my steps on Terminal and followed the file line and deleted my Error 128 LOL and I can't believe it worked T^T This took a good 7 whole hours off my life for an old ass camera and I WANT IT BACK If you read this rant, literally why?
